recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-41583 unless the work group reopens the later formula/determiner or relativeTime decisions; those later issues should not be re-decided as part of this seed.
issue_request: FHIR-41583 was Applied and resolved Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-core Group. It requested Group support for conceptual CohortDefinition use by adding CanonicalResource-style metadata, putting MetadataResource-only metadata on extensions, relaxing Group.type to 0..1 with an invariant, adding conceptual membership, adding combinationMethod and combinationThreshold, expanding Group.characteristic.value[x] to uri and Expression, and adding characteristic elements for description, method, determination, offset, instances, duration, and relative timing.
initial_application: The issue was applied through J#41583 commits in October 2023 that added the conceptual membership code, CanonicalResource template/base, Group metadata elements, combination controls, characteristic additions, terminology, and examples. A later J#41583 commit in October 2025 refined the Group.type invariant to grp-2 and added invariant tests.
additional_context: Later final Group decisions intentionally changed some names and semantics from the original seed wording. FHIR-43499 split determinedBy[x] into Group.characteristic.formula plus Group.characteristic.determiner and removed DeviceMetric from the determiner targets. FHIR-45508 renamed Group.characteristic.timing to Group.characteristic.relativeTime while retaining the RelativeTime datatype supplied by FHIR-41582. FHIR Extension Pack source now carries Group contexts for the artifact/resource metadata extensions corresponding to MetadataResource-only elements.
reconciliation: No core source was changed. Current active Group source has CanonicalResource/template wiring, conceptual membership, grp-2, combinationMethod and combinationThreshold, uri and Expression in characteristic.value[x], description/method/formula/determiner/offset/instances/duration/relativeTime characteristic support, and a conceptual cohort example. The extension-context portion is already represented in the Extension Pack.
